descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says look at, examine, or inspect an object under/with a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Find the object, take it, turn on the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for a simple put/place/move of ONE object into or onto a destination (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet") with no heat, cool, clean, lamp, or count of two.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the object must be cleaned/washed first: "clean", "washed", "rinse", or sink/water use, then placed (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet"). Cleans at the sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the object must be cooled first: "cool", "cold", "chilled", "cooled", or fridge use, then placed (e.g. "put a cold apple on the table"). Cools in the fridge.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the object must be heated first: "heat", "hot", "warm", "cook", or microwave use, then placed (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop"). Heats in the microwave.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task wants TWO of an object kind placed in/on a destination: "two", "2", or a bare plural (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa"). Take one at a time, place both.
